title: Normalize tenant claim mappings and repair missing audit events for private KMS unwraps
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Multiple enterprise Private customers reported missing or truncated audit events correlated with RBAC failures during tenant claim normalization after IDP updates. Impacted flows: SAML assertion -> tenant alias mapping -> service account KMS unwrap. In edge cases when tenant alias contains punctuation or mixed-casing and the SAML group claim is presented as an array, our canonicalizer drops the tenant bind and a downstream KMS unwrap emits an orphaned wrap-record but no corresponding audit entry. This results in failed API calls for private deployments and customer escalations requesting urgent fixes and audit backfills.

Reproduction: 1) Import SAML assertion with groups: ["Org-Engineering","org_admins"] and tenant claim: "Tenant-A_Prod". 2) Trigger service-account rotation that performs KMS envelope unwrap for tenant-specific key. 3) Observe RBAC check returns 403 for resources that should be allowed and control-plane audit log shows unwrap attempt but missing role-binding link.

Root cause hypothesis: The tenant/group canonicalizer (token-normalize module) strips or reorders multi-valued claims in some IDP encoding variants and does not preserve original tenant_alias casing/punctuation. Audit pipeline batches events and truncates event payloads >64KB under high concurrency; the link between unwrap event and role-binding is lost when the tenant key is normalized differently between auth path and audit path.

Mitigation (deployed 2025-02-15): Emergency guardrails added: 1) temporary lenient canonicalization that preserves original tenant_alias as "fallback_raw_tenant" in the auth token, 2) KMS unwrap now retries with fallback tenant mapping, 3) audit pipeline backpressure throttling reduced to avoid truncation during bursts. These reduced customer-visible failures but did not fully restore missing historical audit entries.

Planned permanent fix: 1) Implement deterministic claim canonicalization with a stable sort + canonical punctuation map and ensure canonicalizer is shared library used by both auth and audit pipelines. 2) Add a signing-hash (tenant_binding_id) stored in the auth token to tie unwrap events to role-bindings robustly. 3) Patch audit pipeline to store full unwrap payloads (no truncation) and run a backfill job to reconcile orphaned unwraps to role bindings for the last 30 days. 4) Add end-to-end tests (SAML variants from three major IdPs) and load tests to verify no truncation.

Acceptance criteria: - Private clusters stop seeing new missing-audit incidents for tenant unwraps; - Backfill reconciles >=95% of orphaned unwrap events for affected customers; - New canonicalizer library is in runtime-1.19 and private-2025.02 release; - Postmortem and security review completed before wide rollout.
comments: 2025-02-14 Maya Chen: Customer P1 escalations opened by AcmeCorp and FinSys referencing missing audit entries and RBAC denies during on-prem key rotations. Eng oncall triaged and assigned to Arjun.

2025-02-15 Arjun Patel: Deployed emergency lenient canonicalizer and unwrap-retry fallback to private-controlplane in region eu-west-2. Early signal: 60% reduction in new incidents; still seeing historical orphaned unwraps. Linked hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/12899

2025-02-16 SRE (Lina Gomez): Reduced audit pipeline backpressure threshold and increased max-event-size to 128KB to avoid truncation during bursts. Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/ops/audit-throughput?from=now-48h

2025-02-17 Security (Rafael Ortiz): Requested formal security review for canonicalizer changes and tenant_binding_id approach. Created security checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Tenant+Binding+Auth+Checklist

2025-02-18 Arjun Patel: Started implementing deterministic canonicalizer as a shared Go module (runtime + audit worker). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12456 — unit tests added for three IdP claim formats.

2025-02-19 QA (Priya Nair): Validation plan added: matrix of IdP variants (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin), group-claim encodings (string vs array), tenant alias edgecases, and load test with burst to reproduce truncation. Cycle job created: https://jira.internal.redwood.ai/browse/E2E-2025-08

2025-02-20 Arjun Patel: Backfill plan approved by Product and Security. Backfill will run with write-once reconciliation producing a reconciliation log and customer notification. Estimated backfill window: 8 hours per tenant for heavy customers.
